title: Sum the neighbors
prompt:
Return the **sum of all in-bounds neighbors** of cell (r, c) — the 8 surrounding cells, excluding the cell itself. Implement `process(int[][] g, int r, int c)`.

Example: in `{{1,2},{3,4}}`, cell (0,0) has neighbors 2, 3, 4 → `9`.

tests.name: neighbor sum
tests.hint: Offset table of 8 directions + bounds guard; the cell itself is never included.
